Callout.Name: Burglary in Progress
Callout.Message: Neighbour reporting a break-in next door.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect, rear window forced, still inside.

Script.Line: The window was already open. I was checking nobody was hurt inside.
I have not taken a thing. Feel my pockets, go on.
It is my aunt who lives here. She is away, that is why it is empty.

Lines.Approach: Rear window is in and they are still inside. The neighbours are watching from their kitchen.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
